label: Counterexamples to induction
subgoals: Read the CTI's start state and its bad successor
Decide whether the start state is reachable
Identify the internal values that the design can never produce

label: Adding a lemma
subgoals: Write a lemma that excludes the CTI's start state
Check that the lemma holds initially
Prove the conjunction of the property and the lemma inductive

label: Where lemmas come from
subgoals: Write helper assertions and prove them as assertions
Let k-induction or IC3 strengthen the property automatically
Filter proposed candidate lemmas with the prover
